tasks.short: Separate meat and byproducts and seal specified containers

steps.what: Separate meats and byproducts into the specified containers while preserving batch segregation
Seal filled containers and check closure and segregation

tasks.design: Retain physical separation and sealing with the worker. Container and segregation instructions in {DOCS} remain references; inventory software is not treated as a substitute for handling food.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task consists of physical sorting, handling and closure checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Record systems can trace batches but do not perform this physical task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsuitable material, preventing contamination and preserving segregation.
tasks.human_edge: Careful handling and judgement about abnormal contents or closures.
tasks.altitude: No change to handling time or food-safety responsibility.

reach.task: Assess questionable material or damaged closure

evidence.claim: Retaining physical separation and sealing is an E1 judgement; the digest's records capabilities do not demonstrate handling automation.

assumptions: Boundary covers separation, filling and sealing, excluding separate labelling, stock recording and transport.
Worker directly checks batch identity and container suitability during retained s1 and closure during retained s2; no structured safe-to-pack flag is assumed.
No new software or equipment is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero; existing sealing runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Container types, segregation rules and existing sealing equipment
research_questions: Which contents or closure defects require quality inspection?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross0 and net0. Physical sorting and sealing remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain and distribute specified meat or carcasses

steps.what: Locate and obtain specified meat or carcasses, checking identity and condition
Move and distribute the checked meat to the specified processing destination

tasks.design: Keep retrieval, physical checks and distribution with the worker using existing handling aids. A production request in {OPS_SYSTEM} may identify the requirement, but no new routing or reporting baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work requires selecting actual material and moving it safely to colleagues.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital requests identify requirements without removing material handling.
tasks.still_hard: Material condition, correct batch selection and safe movement.
tasks.human_edge: Checking physical identity and responding to unsuitable material.
tasks.altitude: No change to physical distribution time.

reach.task: Resolve an unsuitable or unavailable material request

evidence.claim: Physical meat retrieval and distribution remain human in this E1 judgement; no relevant labour-saving capability is established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary covers obtaining and distributing specified material, excluding purchase, slaughter and separate inventory records.

Production supervisor supplies the existing request and destination in the unchanged production allocation process. Worker verifies identity and condition in s1; no free suitability or location-exception flag is assumed.
No new capture demand or software is introduced. Existing handling equipment runtime earns no saving and incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Storage layout, handling aids and request clarity
research_questions: Which requests require supervisor approval before substituting a batch?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross0 and net0. Identification, retrieval and physical delivery remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain physical food handling and direct safety checks without invented paperwork savings.
reach: Escalate unsuitable batches to production supervision
Ask quality inspection about suspect material
role.ambitious_version: Consistent physical handling with clear escalation for unsuitable material.
